name: boa
description: BOA (Build On Autopilot): an agent skill that teaches an AI coding agent to run a software project end to end (greenfield, brownfield or refactor) with a complete working discipline.

plugins.name: boa
plugins.description: The build-on-autopilot agent skill: a lead agent and sub-agents (builder, adversarial reviewer, tester, integrator) on a plan, parallel lanes on git worktrees, merge trains, a typed project memory with hybrid search, measuring, safety, pause, resume and close, plus the few generic tools the discipline needs.
